title: Patch Test Triage Algorithm
subtitle: When distribution and persistence justify patch testing

steps.prompt: Eczematous dermatitis with exposure-pattern distribution or chronic/refractory course?
Consider atopic, irritant, seborrheic, stasis, psoriasis, or infection
Face/eyelid, hands, anogenital, occupational, device, topical medication, or shoe pattern?
Patch testing with baseline + exposure-directed series
Does avoidance plus topical therapy clear and stay clear?
Continue allergen/irritant avoidance and relapse monitoring

citations.quote: AAD contact dermatitis guidance describes allergen exposure review and patch testing for allergic contact dermatitis.
American Contact Dermatitis Society Core Allergen Series: 2020 Update supports baseline allergen selection for patch testing.
